issues: Lack of visible interactivity cues (hover states, active indicators) in the static image.
Product cards lack quick-action buttons (e.g., add to cart, wishlist) which are standard for e-commerce.
Design is clean but lacks subtle depth/polish elements (e.g., soft shadows, subtle gradients) to elevate it to world-class.
strengths: Excellent visual hierarchy and clear content organization.
Professional and cohesive color system with a tasteful accent.
Strong typography choices and consistent application.
specific_improvements: Implement subtle hover states for product cards (e.g., slight lift, overlay with quick-add button) and navigation items.
Add quick-action buttons (e.g., 'Add to Cart' or heart icon for wishlist) to product cards, possibly on hover.
Introduce subtle depth elements like soft, diffused shadows on cards or elevated elements to enhance polish.
